label: copy-phase echo of digit 3 (weaker: p)
explanation: Reset-gate unit that fires almost only in the copy phase (99% of mass), when the token fed back as input is a repeated token, mainly the digit 3 (72% of mass, lift 21x), and less often p (20% of mass), with a small tail on l and q. It is nearly silent during the original phase, including when 3 first appears, and on the delimiter step. Magnitude is largest when 3 is the first original token and gets echoed at recall_idx 1 (the top examples all start with 3 and are L=8-9). Activation also rises with absolute step t and L, and with how many digits are in the sequence. Precision is incomplete: only about 43% of copy-phase 3 inputs cross threshold, and we found no simple condition (t, L, recall position, next token, digit count) that separates them cleanly. Predicate (copy phase and input 3): dev F1 0.50, mass recall 0.71. Adding p raises mass recall to 0.91 but drops precision to 0.30.
